plain: Badge now centres its label in the pill (it sat about 2px high), the label sits in an inner span, and the unused --component-badge-paddingShift token is gone.

steps.plain: A Badge's text now sits in an inner span (so does every Badge inside Card, Table, List and the other demos), so a test that reads it with getByText gets the span; use closest('[data-tone]') or a role instead.
The component.badge.paddingShift token (--component-badge-paddingShift, the 1px label lift) is gone because Badge pads evenly now; stop reading it, there is no replacement.
